title: Unbelievably Tender Croatian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and savory stew featuring tender pork, Bramley apples, and a rich deglaze fond, perfect for a comforting meal or hangover cure. This low-carb-friendly dish is a staple of Croatian cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then sear the pork until browned on all sides.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced apples and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften.
Add the chicken broth and red wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the pork to the pot, bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the stew at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the apples are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly, then serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
